si_3_author_journal_year: Guo-Rong Wu and Chris Baeken, Journal of Affective Disorders, 2023
si_4_title: Normative modeling analysis reveals corpus callosum volume changes in early and mid-to-late first episode major depression

dc_1_datasets_using.detail: Data were obtained from the REST-meta-MDD Consortium, specifically using participants from 7 study sites. The dataset included 490 healthy controls and 369 first-episode MDD patients.
dc_1_datasets_using.supporting_text: The structural brain imaging data were acquired from the RESTmeta-MDD Consortium (Chen et al., 2022; Yan et al., 2019) ... Consequently, 369 MDD patients (first episode MDD) and 490 healthy controls were selected from 7 study sites.

answer.REST-meta-MDD: normative training for healthy controls; clinical testing for first-episode MDD patients

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Healthy controls (N=490) were used as the reference dataset to train the normative models. First-episode MDD patients (N=369) were used as the clinical test group to calculate individual z-scores and evaluate volumetric deviations.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: hierarchical Bayesian regression was employed to train the normative models on healthy participants (Rutherford et al., 2022). ... This model was further used to estimate zscores that indicate to what extent an individual's CC volume differs from the norms calculated by the reference dataset (healthy controls).

dc_3_hc_number_normative_model.detail: The study utilized 490 healthy controls from the REST-meta-MDD consortium as the reference dataset for normative modeling. All 490 HCs were used in the training phase using hierarchical Bayesian regression.
dc_3_hc_number_normative_model.supporting_text: Consequently, 369 MDD patients (first episode MDD) and 490 healthy controls were selected from 7 study sites. ... hierarchical Bayesian regression was employed to train the normative models on healthy participants

dc_4_age_info_normative_model.detail: The age of the healthy control group (N=490) is reported with a mean of 37.06 and an SD of 14.42. The same group was used for both the overall and training phases of the normative model.

dc_5_sex_info_normative_model.detail: The healthy control group includes 309 females and 181 males out of a total of 490 participants. Percentages were calculated as 309/490 = 63.1% for females and 181/490 = 36.9% for males.
